notes.title: 🛠️ Dev Log Update – Decorate the Bakery shop of Your Dreams!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 👋

We’re back with a quick but exciting update on Cats & Cakes: The Card Game! 🐾✨

Lately, we’ve been focusing on fleshing out one of our most cozy and creative features yet: the Decorate System! 🎀

[previewyoutube=i9zW2_sa06Y;full][/previewyoutube]

In between baking pastries and serving our demanding (but adorable) feline customers, you’ll now be able to customize your bakery using the Fame you earn from running a successful shop. Think furniture, wallpaper, flooring, tiny trinkets — and even special items that give you gameplay bonuses, [strike]like a strawberry basket that spawns fresh fruit while you work. 🍓[/strike]

Decorating will happen before you open your shop, giving you a peaceful moment to plan and personalize before the pastry chaos begins.

We're working hard to make sure the demo coming this July has a tight and satisfying gameplay loop, and this system adds a whole new layer of creativity and progression to the experience. Whether you’re here for the cozy vibes or the strategic mastery, we want the game to reward you in every way.

Thanks for following our journey, and stay tuned for more sneak peeks and GIFs soon! 💌

🐾 – 2 Cubs Studio

notes.title: Devlog Update: We're Working on the Demo!
notes.notes:
After months of baking up new features, balancing recipes, and refining card mechanics, we’re now preparing a slice of the full experience to give you a first taste of what it's like to run your very own cozy cat-powered bakery.

🧁 What to Expect in the Demo:
Core gameplay loop: stacking cards to bake delicious pastries

Adorable feline customers with their own reactions and quirks

Several starter recipes to unlock

Early upgrades, ingredient trading, and tool use also the automation

A peek at our cozy visuals and card-based strategy

This will be a single-player offline demo with a focused gameplay loop so you can jump in, experiment with recipes, and get a feel for the cozy chaos ahead.

✨ Why This Matters
We want your feedback! The demo will help us:

Fine-tune recipe pacing & card logic

Improve game flow

Spot bugs and polish interactions

Hear what cozy gamers love (and want more of!)

Thank you again for being part of this journey. We’re just two devs working out of love for cozy games, and your support makes every step worthwhile.

Stay tuned — we’ll be sharing more updates and a release date for the demo soon!
🐾💗
